title: WP_REST_API_Type
description: A post type object in a REST API context.

capabilities.description: All capabilities used by the post type. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

description.description: A human-readable description of the post type.

hierarchical.description: Whether or not the post type should have children.

has_archive.description: If the value is a string, the value will be used as the archive slug. If the value is false the post type has no archive.

viewable.description: Whether or not the post type can be viewed. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

labels.description: Human-readable labels for the post type for various contexts. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

name.description: The title for the post type.

slug.description: An alphanumeric identifier for the post type.

supports.description: All features, supported by the post type. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

rest_base.description: REST base route for the post type.

rest_namespace.description: REST route's namespace for the post type.

template.description: The block template associated with the post type.

template_lock.description: The template lock associated with the post type, or false if none.

visibility.description: The visibility settings for the post type. Only present when using the 'edit' context.

show_ui.description: Whether to generate a default UI for managing this post type.

show_in_nav_menus.description: Whether to make the post type available for selection in navigation menus.

icon.description: The icon for the post type.
